subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A teacher and a disruptive student jointly write and sign a written agreement specifying exactly which behaviours the student will change, and what reward/consequence follows, reviewed after an agreed period. This behaviour-management tool is called a:
explanation: A behaviour contract is a written, mutually-agreed commitment specifying target behaviours and consequences, giving the student ownership over the change process — distinct from a token economy (an ongoing token-based reward system) or an IEP (a broader individualised academic plan, typically for a diagnosed disability).
